Step 4: Both forces point in the same direction, so the net electric force on the test charge is directed toward $q_2$.

Từ câu a \( \Rightarrow {P_{{R_x}}} = \frac{{{U^2}}}{{{R_x}}} = \frac{{{{\left( {\frac{{12x}}{{x + 3}}} \right)}^2}}}{x} = \frac{{144x}}{{{x^2} + 6x + 9}} = \frac{{144}}{{x + \frac{9}{x} + 6}}\) Để P Rx max khi \((x + \frac{9}{x} + 6)\,\,\min \)\( \Rightarrow \left( {x + \frac{9}{x}} \right)\,\,\min \) Áp dụng BĐT Cô – si: \(x + \frac{9}{x} \ge 2\sqrt {x.\frac{9}{x}} = 6\) \( \Rightarrow {P_{Rx\,max}} = \frac{{144}}{{6 + 6}} = 12\,\left( W \right)\)
